Signature.Documentation: This test case tests a CB-AdES-B-B signature built on an untagged COSE_Sign1 structure with attached payload. Apart from the protected header parameters alg, CWT Claims (enclosing iat) and x5chain, the implementation shall add the protected kid header parameter (label 4), whose content shall be the DER-encoded IssuerSerial (IETF RFC 5035) of the signing certificate (clause 5.1.4). No other optional component shall be present. The x5chain header parameter shall be a protected header parameter. At least the signing certificate shall be included in x5chain; the certificates needed for building the certification path should also be included.
